ba.help.memberCode: Menu (top-right) → Account → Customer Center → your member code (12–13 characters).
ba.help.characterName: The official site asks you to pick a character after entering the member code — since redemption here is automatic, this optional name tells it who gets the items. Empty = your first character.
ss.help.uid: Open your profile in-game and copy your UID (at least 9 digits).
ss.help.uid.step2: Copy the UID under your name
bd2.help.nickname: Your in-game display name from your profile — not an email/login. Guest_XXXXX names work too.
bd2.help.nickname.step2: Copy your nickname exactly as shown
bd2.help.mail: Rewards arrive in your in-game mailbox — restart the game to see them.
